description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open source testing management project. It defines the logic for generating and configuring document options for reports, including setup for building the document structure, handling user input arguments, initializing GUI elements, and defining print preferences. It also includes logic for handling different document types such as test specifications, requirements specifications, and test plans.

classes.name: printDocOptions
classes.description: Class providing configuration options for document printing and generation preferences, including methods to retrieve various sets of options such as document options, requirement specifications, test specifications, and execution options.

methods.name: getJSPrintPreferences
methods.description: Returns JavaScript representation of the print preferences configuration.

methods.name: getReqSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns options specific to requirement specifications.

methods.name: getTestSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns options specific to test specifications.
